name: Neon Genesis Evangelion
tagline: Teenagers pilot giant mechs against mysterious beings
description: Shinji Ikari is recruited to pilot a giant bio-machine called an Eva to fight mysterious beings known as Angels. What begins as a mecha anime evolves into a psychological deconstruction of the genre and exploration of depression, trauma, and human connection.
seoTitle: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Why It’s a Must-Watch in 2026
seoDescription: Dive into the epic battles of Neon Genesis Evangelion! Uncover its impact on anime and find out why it's essential viewing. Explore now!
